# MM-P1-L2-RR01-S1 Lubrication and fluids - Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #1

Revision: Rev A  
Plant: P1, line P1-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L2-RR01

Scope
This document defines required lubricants and fluid handling procedure for EQ-P1-L2-RR01. It applies to all maintenance activities that introduce or replace lubricants and cooling fluids on the radial ring rolling mill. Reference ECN-2026-009 for engineering changes, SB-1020 for safety boundaries, and SOP-P1-L2-01 for lockout/tagout procedures.

Tools
- Clean drip pan and compatible containment rated for machine oils
- Approved dispensing pump compatible with CFW-LUB-961
- Lint-free rags and absorbent pads
- Personal protective equipment as specified in SB-1020

Procedure
1. Verify lockout/tagout per SOP-P1-L2-01 before opening any lubricant reservoirs on EQ-P1-L2-RR01.  
2. Confirm work area containment is in place and drip pan is positioned to capture fluids.  
3. Use the approved dispensing pump to add lubricant CFW-LUB-961 into the designated lubrication points only. Do not substitute other products.  
4. When servicing rolling operations involving rings, ensure ring outer diameter does not exceed the maximum ring outer diameter for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L2-RR01) is 995 mm. Maintain clearance and containment during handling.  
5. Wipe fittings and reservoir fill ports clean before and after servicing. Dispose of used rags and absorbents following SB-1020 waste procedures.  
6. Record lubricant part number used and service notes in maintenance log. Report any deviations to maintenance engineering per ECN-2026-009.

Acceptance criteria
- Lubricant used on EQ-P1-L2-RR01 is CFW-LUB-961.  
- No visible leakage from reservoirs or fittings after reassembly and system purge.  
- Work area is restored and waste materials are disposed according to SB-1020.  
- Maintenance log entry confirms lubricant part number and references SOP-P1-L2-01 lockout completion and any relevant ECN-2026-009 items.
